Errors.connection: The request didn’t go through because the connection dropped. Check your internet, then try again.
Errors.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again, then retry.

dyslexia.label: Dyslexia
dyslexia.blurb: Short chunks, simpler sentences, a key-term glossary, and a read-aloud button.

deaf_hoh.label: Deaf or hard of hearing
deaf_hoh.blurb: Captions of the whole lecture and a written concept map of how its ideas connect.

Auth.profileLegend: How should we shape your study material?
Auth.confirmNotice: Account created. Check your email for a confirmation link, then sign in.
Auth.pitchHeading: The lecture, made readable. The paperwork, handled.
Auth.pitchBody: Upload a recording. Get study material shaped to how you learn, then let AccessBridge write the accommodation request your professor will actually take seriously.
Auth.dense1: Residuals are the gaps between predictions and reality.
Auth.dense2: Heteroscedasticity: those gaps change size as the predictor grows.
Auth.dense3: Ordinary least squares assumes the gaps stay the same size.

Dashboard.title: Your lectures
Dashboard.loadFailed: Problem: We couldn’t load your lectures. Refresh the page to try again.
Dashboard.emptyBody: Upload your first recording to start building your library.

UploadPage.title: Upload a lecture
UploadPage.intro: Add a recording and we’ll keep it safe in your private library. Only you can open it.

ProfileSwitch.note: New study material will follow the profile you choose. Material you already made keeps its old shape until you press “Make study material again” on that lecture.

TranscriptStatus.transcribing: Transcribing. This can take a few minutes.
TranscriptStatus.transcribingFor: Transcribing {title}. This can take a few minutes.
TranscriptStatus.startError: We couldn’t start the transcript. Try again.

GenerationStatus.making: Making your study material. This can take a minute or two.
GenerationStatus.none: Your transcript is ready. Make study material for your {profile} profile.
GenerationStatus.startError: We couldn’t start the study material. Try again.

Lecture.noProfile: Problem: We couldn’t find your study profile, so we can’t tailor the material. Sign out and back in.
Lecture.loadFailed: Problem: We couldn’t load your study material. Refresh the page to try again.
Lecture.materialSoon: Your study material will appear here.

Study.emphasisedNone: The transcript shows nothing the lecturer stressed in words.

Concept.title: Concept map
Concept.unavailable: The concept map couldn’t be made this time because the study-material service was busy or out of its daily limit. Your captions and glossary below are complete. Choose “Make study material again” under Progress to try the map again later.
Concept.old: This study material was made before concept maps existed. Choose “Make study material again” under Progress to add one.
Concept.intro: How the ideas in this lecture connect. Each idea is listed with what it links to, written as a sentence. The last word of each sentence is a link to that idea.

ReadAloud.stateLoading: Loading audio. This can take a few seconds.
ReadAloud.announceLoading: Loading audio for {label}. This can take a few seconds.
ReadAloud.announceReady: Audio for {label} is ready. Choose Play to listen.
ReadAloud.cantPlayDevice: We couldn’t play the audio on this device. Try again.
ReadAloud.cantPlay: The audio couldn’t be played. Try again.

Accommodation.intro: Draft a short email to your professor asking for what fits your {profile} profile. You can change every word, and nothing is sent until you choose Send email.
Accommodation.senderTitle: Sending isn’t set up for professors yet.
Accommodation.senderBody: You can still write and edit a draft, then copy it into your own email. Choosing Send email will be rejected until the site owner verifies a sending address.
Accommodation.resumeTitle: You have an unsent draft from {date}.
Accommodation.resumeBody: Pick up where you left off, or write a new one.
Accommodation.drafting: Writing your draft. This can take a few seconds.
Accommodation.bodyHint: Replace [Your name] with your name. {count} of {max} characters.
Accommodation.replaceBody: A new draft replaces the message above, including the changes you made. The professor’s address stays.
Accommodation.announceEdits: You have edits in this message. Choose Replace with a new draft, or Keep my edits.
Accommodation.announceResumedSaved: Resumed your draft with the edits you made in this browser. Check the message, then choose Send email.
Accommodation.announceResumed: Resumed your draft. Check the message, then choose Send email.
Accommodation.announceReady: Draft ready. Enter your professor’s email address, read the message, then choose Send email.

FollowUp.intro: Add a reminder to check for your professor’s reply. It’s a calendar file you open yourself; nothing is shared.
FollowUp.downloaded: Downloaded {file}. Open it to add the reminder for {when} to your calendar.
FollowUp.problem: Problem: We couldn’t make the calendar file. Try again.

Chat.hint: Press Enter to send, or Shift and Enter for a new line.
Chat.notSaved: Note: This answer couldn’t be saved, so it won’t be here after you reload.
Chat.announceWait: {busy}. This can take a few seconds.
Chat.lectureBusy: Finding the answer in the transcript
Chat.lectureIntro: Ask about anything in this lecture. Answers come only from the transcript, and if it doesn’t say, you’ll be told so.
Chat.siteIntro: Ask how to use AccessBridge: where to find things and what each feature does. I can’t help with anything else. This chat isn’t saved and clears when you leave this page.
Chat.notReady: This lecture’s transcript isn’t ready yet, so there is nothing to ask about. Check the Progress section of the page.

Upload.stopToSwitch: Stop the recording to switch back to uploading a file.
Upload.formats: MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, WebM, MP4 or MOV. Up to {size}.
Upload.doneBody: {title} ({size}) is in your library. Start its transcript from your lectures page.
Upload.oneAtATime: Add one recording at a time. Drop a single file, then upload the next one afterwards.
Upload.errInterrupted: The upload was interrupted because the connection dropped. Check your internet, then choose Upload lecture to try again.
Upload.errTooLarge: The server rejected the file as too large. The limit is {limit}.
Upload.errSession: Your session has ended, so the upload was not saved. Sign in again, then retry.
Upload.errStorage: Lecture storage isn’t set up yet, so nothing was saved. Try again later.
Upload.errFailed: The upload failed and nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
Upload.errCancelled: Upload cancelled. Nothing was saved. Your file is still selected.
Upload.errNoTitle: Give the lecture a title so you can find it later.
Upload.errSave: The recording uploaded but the lecture could not be saved, so we removed it. Try again.

Record.errBlockedMsg: Microphone access is blocked, so nothing was recorded.
Record.errBlockedHelp: Allow the microphone for this site in your browser’s address-bar or site settings, then choose Try again. You can also switch to Upload a file.
Record.errNoMicMsg: No microphone was found on this device.
Record.errNoMicHelp: Plug in or turn on a microphone, then choose Try again. You can also switch to Upload a file.
Record.errBusyMsg: The microphone could not be started. Another app or tab may be using it.
Record.errBusyHelp: Close anything else that uses the microphone, then choose Try again.
Record.errUnexpectedMsg: Recording could not start because of an unexpected problem.
Record.errUnexpectedHelp: Choose Try again. If it keeps failing, use Upload a file instead.
Record.errFormatMsg: This browser can’t record audio in a format we can use.
Record.errFormatHelp: Try a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, or use Upload a file.
Record.errEmptyMsg: Nothing was captured. The recording is empty.
Record.errEmptyHelp: Choose Try again and speak for a few seconds before stopping.
Record.errBadTypeMsg: This browser recorded in a format we can’t accept ({type}).
Record.insecureTitle: Recording needs a secure (https) connection, and this page isn’t on one.
Record.insecureHelp: Open AccessBridge at its https address to record.
Record.noRecorderHelp: Try a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
Record.stillUpload: You can still use Upload a file.
Record.announceStopped: Recording stopped. {duration} recorded. Play it back, then use it or record again.
Record.announceDiscarded: Recording discarded. You can record again.
Record.announceReady: Recording ready. Add a title and choose Upload lecture.
Record.noticeSize: Recording stopped by itself at the {limit} size limit. Everything up to that point is kept.
Record.noticeInterrupted: The recording was interrupted. What was captured so far is kept.
Record.noticeMic: The microphone stopped working, so the recording ended. What was captured so far is kept.
Record.micGranted: Microphone access: already allowed for this site. Nothing records until you choose Start recording.
Record.micDenied: Microphone access: blocked in your browser settings. Allow it for this site, then choose Start recording.
Record.micUnknown: Microphone access: not asked for yet. Your browser will ask for permission when you choose Start recording.
Record.requesting: Requesting microphone access. Choose Allow in the browser’s permission prompt.
Record.keepOpen: Keep this tab open while you record. Stopping lets you play the recording back before anything is uploaded.
Record.nothingUploaded: Nothing is uploaded until you choose Use this recording, then Upload lecture.
